up: Retrieve all exact activity measurements from the assay with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL4649971. For each activity, include the compound's ChEMBL ID, compound name, canonical SMILES, and the activity details: standard type, standard value, standard units, standard relation (which should be '='), and pchembl value. Only include rows where the standard relation is '=' and standard value is not null. Do not apply any other filters beyond those needed to identify the assay and the exact activity condition. Return all matching rows without limiting.
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id,
  md.pref_name AS compound_name,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_type,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.pchembl_value
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
LEFT JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649971'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
